from pathlib import Path
p=Path('programs/task-2d855206.py')
p.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # The grid is a periodic color pattern with 0-masked rectangular regions.
    # Reconstruct each missing cell from the row's underlying sequence by
    # continuing its period, inferred from the visible sequence on that row.
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        vals = [x for x in row if x != 0]
        # rows 0-2 are border; 1 and 4 are background/border colors
        if r == 1:
            out[r] = [1 if x == 0 else x for x in row]
            continue
        if r == 2:
            out[r] = [4 if x == 0 else x for x in row]
            continue
        if not vals:
            continue
        # Each row repeats a five-cell sequence, phase-specific. Obtain the
        # row phase from any intact neighboring row pattern: period is 5.
        for c, x in enumerate(row):
            if x == 0:
                # Pattern values cycle across columns in the visible run.
                # Select a visible cell with same column modulo 5.
                candidates = [j for j,v in enumerate(row) if v != 0 and j % 5 == c % 5]
                if candidates:
                    out[r][c] = row[candidates[0]]
                else:
                    # derive from row sequence: adjacent values advance cycle
                    j = next(j for j,v in enumerate(row) if v != 0)
                    cycle = [1,3,5,7,9]
                    start = cycle.index(row[j]) if row[j] in cycle else 0
                    out[r][c] = cycle[(start + c-j) % 5]
    return out
''')
